verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: One-Handed Kamehameha mk.II — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the Xenoverse 2 skill page, Ultimate Attack index, and broader Dragon Ball reference material. The move is treated as the mk.II Ultimate variant and kept distinct from One-Handed Kamehameha and DUAL One-handed Kamehameha.
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies One-Handed Kamehameha mk.II as a Ki Blast Ultimate used by Future Gohan, with a variable 400–600 Ki cost and up to 100 Stamina used for its defensive/evasive property.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The skill is taught by Future Gohan through Training — Lesson 4, making the mentor route the supported acquisition record.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed evidence establishes a training/mentor acquisition route rather than an Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: The mk.II variant is kept separate from One-Handed Kamehameha and DUAL One-handed Kamehameha despite their related names and mechanics.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Reported damage percentages and community test values are not promoted to canonical database damage values because they vary with character stats, build, and game conditions.

records.name: One-Handed Kamehameha mk.II
records.skill_description: Backflip and fire a one-handed Kamehameha; a second input fires an additional blast, while the skill can also be used while the user is being attacked by spending Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: The user performs two backflips before firing the beam. A second input fires another blast from the opposite hand. The move has a defensive/evasive property that permits use while sustaining enemy attacks at an additional Stamina cost.
